ValidationRule.description: Prevents updates to PHOCS Assessment records when Status is Completed, unless the user has the EHIS Bypass Validation Rule custom permission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSAssessment", NOT($Permission.EHISBypassValidationRuleCustomPermission), NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Type), "Risk Assessment"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(AssessmentStatus), "Completed") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Assessment record cannot be edited once the status is marked as Completed
